newsitem.title: USA: Zeigler sees Q2 mid-teen percentage growth.
newsitem.headline: Zeigler sees Q2 mid-teen percentage growth.

text.p: Zeigler Coal Holding Co said Tuesday it expects second quarter earnings to reflect mid-teen percentage growth over the $0.45 per share reported during 1996 second quarter.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report second quarter earnings of $0.60 a share, according to First Call estimates.
The company said in a statement that quarterly earnings would have been higher were it not for continued development expenses within the technology segment and certain other timing-related factors.
"I remain confident that we are on track for a strong 1997," Zeigler President and Chief Executive Chand Vyas said in the statement.
